lead.title: OMass Therapeutics raises $310M Series C to fund Phase 2 of its oral MC2R antagonist
lead.deck: Co-led by Bain Capital Life Sciences, Forbion and Novo Holdings, the round is the second-largest private European biotech raise of 2026, according to European Biotechnology. OMS1620, in Phase 1 single-ascending-dose testing, will target congenital adrenal hyperplasia and ACTH-dependent Cushing's syndrome.

milestone.title: Paul Stoffels launches Armed Cell Therapeutics and licenses the preclinical CAR-Ts dropped by Galapagos (Lakefront)
milestone.summary: Armed gets the CAR-T programs that came from AboundBio (acquired by Galapagos in 2022) for about $9M upfront, $230M in milestones and royalties. The CAR-Ts, armed with extra payloads, target non-Hodgkin lymphoma and small cell lung cancer, aiming to curb relapse.
milestone.why: A high-pedigree launch (Paul Stoffels is chair and interim CEO, John Mellors is chief scientific officer) that recycles assets shelved by a listed Belgian company, with no round announced: a weak signal ahead of a first financing.

deal.thesis: AstraZeneca pays $40M upfront (up to $1.46B in milestones, plus royalties) for insitro's Virtual Human platform to identify causal targets in MASH and cardiomyopathies. A big pharma is paying for AI target discovery rather than molecules, right after the Phase 3 failure of Wainua in ATTR-CM.

brefsEurope.title: BIO-Europe survey: access to capital is the top barrier to dealmaking for European biotechs
brefsEurope.summary: Of 81 executives, mostly from private preclinical or early-clinical biotechs, 34 cite capital availability as the main obstacle, ahead of the valuation gap (13) and competition from Chinese assets (12). Nearly 80% blame investor risk aversion for the scarcity of capital.

brefsIntl.title: Gilead takes an equity stake in Vir with a deal worth up to $1.87B for three T cell engagers
brefsIntl.summary: Gilead buys into Vir and signs a deal worth up to $1.87B on three T cell engagers: one more comparable for the modality.

brefsIntl.title: Roche signs a $1B+ obesity deal with Rona, another purchase of a Chinese asset
brefsIntl.summary: Roche expands its obesity R&D with a pact worth over a billion dollars, in its series of acquisitions of China-origin assets.

brefsIntl.title: Crescent Biopharma has dosed over 125 patients with its PD-1 x VEGF bispecific CR-001 in the ASCEND trial
brefsIntl.summary: The Phase 1/2 trial is enrolling in the US, Europe and South Korea and is opening cohorts combined with standard-of-care chemotherapy.

word.definition: A family of proteins embedded in the cell membrane that pick up signals (hormones, neurotransmitters) and relay them inside the cell; they are the target of about a third of FDA-approved drugs.

parts.label: Intracellular part
parts.role: the relay to the G protein

how.t: A hormone or drug attaches to the receptor and changes its shape.
The receptor recruits a G protein inside the cell.
The signaling cascade triggers the cell's response, which a drug can amplify (agonist) or block (antagonist).

word.why: GPCRs remain a major target class, but obtaining them in stable, functional form is a bottleneck. Hence investor interest in platforms that can study them in their native environment: OMass just raised $310M for an antagonist of MC2R, a GPCR.

startups.name: OMass Therapeutics
startups.use: OdyssION platform (native mass spectrometry) to study targets in their natural protein environment; OMS1620, an oral MC2R antagonist, heading to Phase 2; $310M Series C.

startups.name: Scape Bio
startups.use: Designs de novo mini-proteins of 40 to 70 amino acids against GPCRs; 11 GPCRs targeted, picomolar-potency binders, a lead program in migraine; seed round under way.

startups.name: Nuclera
startups.use: GPCR-focused nanodisc panel paired with its eProtein Discovery cell-free protein synthesis platform, to produce active receptors in 48 hours (announced March 30, 2026).
